messages:
alex: Heads up — production websocket fleet is seeing a reconnect spike since the canary rolled at ~08:12. reconnect rate jumped to ~0.9% (baseline ~0.03%).

alex: Quick triage log snippet: 
```
streamer-12d ERROR state-serialize failed id=tenant-42 sess=abcd1234 checksum=0x9f -> 0x7c
streamer-12d WARN client-reconnect reason=protocol-mismatch proto=v2 expected=v1
```

maria: ugh. that looks like the serialization refactor PR (jing's) that landed in canary. @jing you changed the on-disk/session wire header, right?

jing: yep — PR #1123 added a compact header and dropped the legacy version byte to save 12 bytes/session. we tested locally and on canary cluster with synthetic traffic but maybe we missed edge cases where proxies replay sessions.

samir: do we have a metric breaking down reconnects by tenant and sess_proto? console currently only shows overall reconnect rate.

alex: no, not yet — that's why it's noisy. I can query the traces for the error tag but need a quick flag to surface proto.

jing: simple fix: runtime should accept both header variants (fallback) and emit metric tag `sess_proto` with values `v1` or `v2`. I can push a hotfix.

maria: prefer a guarded migration: add fallback + metric, then flip canary to 30% and watch. if >0.5% reconnect -> rollback.

samir: agree. also add a dashboard tile: reconnect rate by sess_proto and by route (routing weight) so we can see if routing policy is causing certain shards to hit legacy proxies.

alex: we also need an alert: if tenant-level reconnect rate >0.2% over 5m AND more than 100 sessions, page oncall. otherwise post to #eng-runtime.

deploy-bot: canary rollout: streamer-runtime-v2 -> cluster-canary-1 (10%) at 08:12 by jing.

alert-bot: alert fired: streaming-reconnects-high (prod) at 08:26 — global rate 0.92% (5m).

jing: patch ready: runtime will attempt v2 parse, fall back to v1, and increment metric `stream.session.proto` (tagged). pushing to canary as hotfix now.

alex: nice. also add logs to include `route_id` and `proxy-id` permittable in prod logs (obfuscated) so we can map to routing policy. small snippet for ops: 
```bash
# quick search for mismatch samples
kubectl logs -l app=streamer -n prod --since=15m | grep "state-serialize failed" | head -n 30
```

maria: I'll update the console dashboard: new tile `Reconnects by sess_proto` + heatmap by route. Adding a small UX note to the rollout page to remind engs to emit `sess_proto` for protocol changes.

samir: after hotfix we should run a targeted scan: replay 5k synthetic sessions through legacy proxies and ensure no checksum mismatch. I can schedule that on the canary cluster.

alex: plan summary: 1) jing hotfix -> fallback parsing + metric 2) maria updates dashboard & alert 3) samir runs synthetic validation 4) if metrics stable at <0.2% for 30m, promote rollout to 50%, then 100%. If >0.5% at any point -> rollback to v1.

jing: hotfix deployed to canary (rolling). will post progress.

deploy-bot: rollout update: streamer-runtime-v2-hotfix -> cluster-canary-1 (rolling, 10% -> 10%) at 08:41.

alex: thanks — assign owners: jing (hotfix + followup PR), maria (dashboard + alert), samir (validation). I'll own the rollback decision.

maria: adding a short-term telemetry tag dump to S3 so we can run ad-hoc analytics if needed. link will be in the rollout ticket. :thumbsup:

alert-bot: resolved: streaming-reconnects-high (prod) at 09:05 — global rate down to 0.08% (5m).

alex: great. postmortem checklist: note the missing header version in the PR, add test that simulates proxy replay, and improve rollout UX to require `sess_proto` metric emission for protocol changes.

samir: filing the validation job now — will ping when done.

jing: follow-up PR opened with tests and a migration note: https://git/redwood/streamer/pull/1138

alex: closing thread for now. thanks everyone.
